use_case_summary: HelpFuse is a ticket automation SaaS that builds automated triage + agent-assist features for mid-market customers. Primary workloads: nightly batch summarization of inbound tickets, real-time agent suggestions (chat-like assistant) and server-side tool calls to create/update Zendesk tickets. Requirements: structured JSON output for field mapping (priority, category, TLDR, suggested_reply), support for function/tool-calling to invoke internal webhook that patches tickets, latency target ~200-500ms for live suggestions, summarization acceptable up to ~1s. Cost-sensitive: wants small/quantized models for routine summarization, fallback to larger model for complex escalations. No on-prem requirement; public cloud ok. Must have SSO (SAML) and SOC2 evidence. Wants API key rotation and audit logs.
